newsitem.title: USA: U.S. weekly rice cash market summary -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. weekly rice cash market summary -- USDA.

text.p: In the South, rice prices were steady to $1.00 lower. Long grain milled rice prices were quoted mostly at $19.00-$20.00 per cwt.; Medium grain was quoted mostly at $17.50-$18.00; Second heads were steady; Brewers were steady. Rice by-products were uneven, bran was 5.00- higher to 3.00 lower, millfeed was steady to 3.00 lower.
In California, rice prices were steady with medium grain selling mostly at $18.00, second heads were steady, bran was unevenly $2.00 lower to $5.00 higher.
California rice ship loadings: For the week ending August 16, no rice ships were loaded.

Inspections of California rice for export: For the week ending August 16, there were no rice inspections. The yearly total since October 1, 1996 was 10,359,531 cwt compared to 6,992,387 cwt a year ago.
Feed by-products prices (dollars per short ton, FOB mills).
